note: Semantics supplied by the user (hand sketch, 2026-08-15): 9/10/11 are the roadways, 1/2 the crosswalks, 3/4/5 the sidewalk under the camera, 12/13/14 the east side, 6/7/8 the south side reached by crossing Baxter. Zone_11 is Hull St.

Zone_09.name: road_junction_box
Zone_09.note: the junction box only. It used to double as the east arm, which meant a car merely standing in it could read as having left eastbound. Split at the line the user drew on 2026-08-19: the far half became Zone_15, and this zone lost its center_and_arm special case, so Hull now matches the other sites - the box is crossed, never an endpoint.

Zone_15.name: road_baxter_east_arm
Zone_15.note: Baxter east arm, the far half of the old Zone_09 beyond the user-drawn line. A vehicle counts as entering or leaving eastbound only by crossing that line.

ped_groups_note: Three pedestrian directions, one per corner of this T junction, set with the user 2026-08-20. Frame orientation, read off the three roadway zones: left = north (Hull), top = east (Baxter east), right = south, bottom = west. Zone_12/13/14 front Sanford and Barbara Orkin Hall on the east side of Hull St - they are Hull's east side, not Baxter's east arm, which is where an earlier draft label went wrong.
arms_note: Three arms at this T junction: Zone_15 (Baxter east), Zone_10 (Baxter west), Zone_11 (Hull north). Zone_09 is the junction box and is never a movement endpoint.
